title: EngramFold population policy
description: Declares the repository phase and, per population, whether an empty population is legitimate. The authoritative validation is engramfold.registry.store.load_populations; this schema exists for readers outside this codebase.

phase.description: Must equal engramfold.STATUS and the STATUS line in README.md.

zero_allowed_reason.description: Required when policy is OPTIONAL, forbidden otherwise. A population authorised to be empty must state why.
